anti_overlap: fd-playwright-dom-extraction covers low-level Playwright techniques for token and DOM extraction
fd-css-design-token-reverse-engineering covers static CSS analysis techniques
fd-component-pattern-cataloging and fd-ux-flow-and-state-analysis cover what to extract
decision_lens: Prioritizes what can ship as a usable skill today with existing APIs over what would require building new infrastructure. A working 80% solution that runs unattended is worth more than a perfect 100% solution requiring per-site tuning.
focus: How to package UI/UX analysis capabilities into a reusable Claude Code plugin or automated skill
name: fd-uiux-workflow-plugin
persona: A developer tools engineer who has built Claude Code plugins and AI-assisted dev workflows. Focuses on what makes a tool repeatable, composable, and safe to run autonomously on arbitrary websites.
review_areas: Evaluate Claude Code plugin architecture (MCP server model, skill YAML format) for hosting a ui-analyze skill that accepts a URL and emits a structured design report
Assess the Playwright MCP server already available in the environment as the browser automation substrate — capabilities and gaps
Research how to structure output artifacts: a canonical JSON schema for a design system report that downstream agents can consume
Examine caching and incremental analysis strategies using the intercache MCP server available in the environment
Evaluate which extraction steps require a vision model pass vs which are pure DOM/CSS
Assess ethical and legal constraints: rate limiting, robots.txt compliance, ToS considerations for target reference sites
success_hints: A concrete skill spec (inputs, outputs, tool calls, output schema) for a ui-analyze skill implementable using existing Playwright MCP
A clear build-vs-use decision: which parts are covered by existing MCP tools and which require a new MCP server
task_context: The Shadow Work Tauri/React desktop app needs design inspiration from complex data-visualization and simulation UIs. Goal is automated extraction of design tokens and component patterns from reference sites using tools available to an AI coding agent in 2026.
